column1: # Known gaps: run by the conformance test and counted, not enforced.
# Hand-written rows (categories that do not start with UniMorph or kaikki): written for this pack, no third-party data.

# Source: UniMorph lat (https://github.com/unimorph/lat/blob/050924c9f013e6aba4d7c87be243a1d79b6c5b10/lat, sha256 7aed5a2fd17c2947), CC BY-SA 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/), by the UniMorph contributors, from English Wiktionary; and kaikki.org's Latin extract of English Wiktionary (2026-10-30, sha256 621efbea7ffcec74), CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/), by the Wiktionary contributors via wiktextract.

# 1000 rows sampled with seed 1 by sources/build-corpus.mjs (UniMorph: 260 noun, 50 proper noun, 120 adjective, 100 participle, 150 verb, active, 70 verb, passive, 40 verb, infinitive, gerund, supine or participle; kaikki: 160 verb, perfect system, 25 adjective, comparison, 25 pronoun or determiner); the rows the pack's rules reach are in corpus.tsv, the others in gaps.tsv. Terms are the lemmas without macrons, as dictionaries write headwords.
